name: player_update_timed_hit_status_from_source
description: Player::UpdateTimedHitStatusFromHitSource routes hit sources into the player timed-hit status and returns the remaining damage value.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a Player combat/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43b790 validates flag 0x800 selecting masterCommonData->maxHealth as the contribution, otherwise using masterCommonData->invMaxHealth * damage, and returning zero only when HitSource::UpdateTimedStatus returns band 1.
The native smoke covers the fixed-contribution path, scaled path, and band-1 damage suppression path.
